spine: 1. tsrs 是 Cloudflare、VoidZero 與 Max Schwenk 協作、在 Oxc 孵化的 TypeScript 編譯器 Rust 移植版，定位是不分叉、忠實移植，設計權留給 TypeScript 團隊。
2. 效能主張是 up to 8x 更快、約 70% 更少記憶體，對照 TypeScript 7.0、相同 type check worker 數，屬早期基準，應讀成上限而非平均。
3. 比較條件才是重點：與 TypeScript 團隊確認同一組設定；文章批評他人基準常用更大機器與非預設選項；預設自適應模式用更多記憶體但更快，文章未給該模式數字。
4. 7.1 beta 最高快 2.5x，部分優化自 tsrs 回送上游，是比基準細節更可核對的事實。
5. 選 Rust 的論點是 Wasm：編 Go 到 Wasm 要連垃圾回收器一起編；加上 AI 讓大規模移植幾天可成，供給與需求兩個理由並列。
6. 不分叉的代價是維護：合併 tsc-rs、Vinext 式每日 agent 審閱上游、診斷順序等差異要在穩定版前收斂、效能改進嘗試回送上游。
7. 設計含意與讀者行動：型別檢查器進入同一條 Rust 工具鏈（Oxlint）、上游也在優化；實際使用應在自己專案上用文章的比較條件重量，證據仍是單一廠商來源。

perspective.mechanism: 以忠實移植加每日 agent 同步的方式維護一個 Rust 版 TypeScript 編譯器；效能數字附著在相同 worker 數與同一組設定上，Wasm 目標是選 Rust 的主要論點。
perspective.tradeoff: 忠實移植換到相容性與上游關係，代價是永遠追上游；預設自適應模式更快但用更多記憶體；Rust 的 Wasm 優勢只針對 Wasm 目標。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師可照文章的比較條件在自己專案上重量時間與記憶體，先試 npm 上的實驗版，不要放進擋合併的 CI；以 7.1 beta 的上游回送作為較可核對的證據。

notes.quote: Cloudflare and VoidZero are now working with Max Schwenk of Owner.com on tsrs, a Rust port of the TypeScript compiler.
notes.interpretation: 協作方與專案定義；發布日期 2026-10-20 來自頁面結構化資料（抓取回報）。

notes.quote: Our goal is to help developers spend less time waiting for their code to be checked and more time building.
notes.interpretation: 動機是縮短等型別檢查的時間。

notes.quote: incubating tsrs as part of the Oxc JavaScript compiler toolchain
notes.interpretation: tsrs 在 Oxc 工具鏈中孵化。

notes.quote: To be clear, we are not forking TypeScript.
notes.interpretation: 專案定位：不分叉。

notes.quote: the TypeScript team should remain in full control of the language’s design and direction.
notes.interpretation: 設計權留在 TypeScript 團隊。

notes.quote: A Rust port has to follow those decisions closely, or it will eventually fall apart and become incompatible.
notes.interpretation: 移植版必須緊跟上游決策。

notes.quote: Early benchmarks of our Rust port of TypeScript are promising
notes.interpretation: 文章自稱早期基準。同句接 tsrs is up to 8x faster and uses ~70% less memory compared to TypeScript 7.0（抓取時句子被截斷並省略冒號，見 n08）。

notes.quote: tsrs is up to 8x faster and uses ~70% less memory compared to TypeScript 7.0
notes.interpretation: 核心效能主張，up to 與 ~ 是來源自身的保留。

notes.quote: compared to TypeScript 7.0 when using the same number of type check workers
notes.interpretation: 比較條件之一：相同 type check worker 數。對 worker 的解釋是我的背景知識。

notes.quote: We worked with the TypeScript team to ensure the above benchmarks are comparing the same configuration.
notes.interpretation: 與 TypeScript 團隊確認比較的是同一組設定。基準放在專案 bench 目錄一事出自第一次抓取摘要，無逐字句，文中以「文章只交代」帶過。

notes.quote: often due to using larger machine types and different options compared to TypeScript's defaults
notes.interpretation: 文章對其他移植版基準主張出入的解釋（前半句為 You may have seen recent benchmarks of different TypeScript ports with various performance claims）。

notes.quote: making TypeScript 7.1 beta up to 2.5x faster than TypeScript 7.0
notes.interpretation: TypeScript 7.1 beta 最高快 2.5x。8 除以 2.5 等於 3.2 是我的算術，來源未比較。

notes.quote: Some of these optimizations were upstreamed from tsrs, and we're hoping to find more.
notes.interpretation: 部分優化自 tsrs 回送上游。原文 tsrs 為 code 格式，此處去掉格式符號。我未核對上游紀錄。

notes.quote: uses more memory but is even faster
notes.interpretation: 預設自適應設定（依機器類型）用更多記憶體但更快；前文為 By default, tsrs ships with an adaptive configuration dependent on the machine type that。文章未給該模式具體數字（我讀到的版本）。

notes.quote: You can try an experimental release by installing the tsrs package from npm
notes.interpretation: 實驗版，npm 安裝；原句以冒號結尾。

notes.quote: TypeScript in Rust aims to be a faithful port of TypeScript.
notes.interpretation: 目標是忠實移植。

notes.quote: the TypeScript team’s port of TypeScript from JavaScript to Go
notes.interpretation: TypeScript 團隊自己的 JavaScript 到 Go 的移植，作為時間背景。

notes.quote: We have now seen slopforks, faithful ports, and completely re-architected versions of TypeScript in Rust or C++.
notes.interpretation: 文章對近期移植版的三種分類；兩條軸線的延伸是我的。

notes.quote: However, frontier AI models can now do large-scale ports almost independently in a matter of days.
notes.interpretation: AI 讓大規模移植幾天可成；未見實測支持，文中標為來源主張。

notes.quote: When you compile a Go program to Wasm, you have to compile Go’s garbage collector along with it.
notes.interpretation: Go 到 Wasm 要連同 GC；圖中右欄沒有對應方塊是對照另一面，非另外量測。

notes.quote: Rust offers some unique advantages
notes.interpretation: 後接 running in WebAssembly，連結指向 @tsrs/wasm（抓取回報連結指向該套件）。

notes.quote: with the new Emscripten target for wasm-bindgen
notes.interpretation: Workers 上 Rust 支援相關的新 Emscripten target；與 including right in your browser 為同一來源的不同片段。

notes.quote: including right in your browser
notes.interpretation: 目標是讓完整開發環境出現在更多地方，包括瀏覽器。

notes.quote: we are working with Theo Browne to merge tsc-rs and tsrs into a single package
notes.interpretation: 與 Theo Browne 合併 tsc-rs 與 tsrs。

notes.quote: supports all of TypeScript's features including Language Server Protocol (LSP) and content mappers
notes.interpretation: 合併後的目標範圍，是目標而非現況；原句為片段。

notes.quote: Each morning, an agent reviews the changes, fetches diffs, and opens tracking issues for anything that could affect Vinext.
notes.interpretation: Vinext 既有的每日同步流程；人做什麼是我的推測。

notes.quote: We will apply the same process to TypeScript
notes.interpretation: tsrs 沿用同一流程；原句為片段。

notes.quote: there are some differences to the upstream version of TypeScript right now
notes.interpretation: 現況與上游有差異；原句為片段。

notes.quote: the order in which diagnostics are printed
notes.interpretation: 差異的例子是診斷訊息輸出順序。

notes.quote: We aim to reduce those differences to a minimum by the time we publish a stable release.
notes.interpretation: 目標是穩定版前把差異降到最低，是 aim 不是承諾。

notes.quote: we’ll attempt to contribute them back to the TypeScript Go codebase
notes.interpretation: 效能改進嘗試回送，attempt 是來源的保留；原句為片段。

notes.quote: for example for type-aware lint rules in Oxlint
notes.interpretation: 下一步計畫之一：整合進堆疊，例如 Oxlint 的型別感知 lint 規則；共用解析結果與記憶體是我的推測。

notes.quote: The Oxc team has already begun refactoring the codebase to make it faster, use less memory, and make it maintainable.
notes.interpretation: Oxc 團隊已開始重構。

notes.quote: they are experimenting with memory and performance improvements for tsc.
notes.interpretation: TypeScript 團隊在試驗 tsc 的記憶體與效能改進，experimenting 是來源的保留。
